entries.label: Rating
entries.desc: Football: expected points margin against an average FBS team on a neutral field. Basketball: adjusted efficiency margin, points per 100 possessions against an average Division I team.

entries.label: Offense
entries.desc: Points (football: per game; basketball: per 100 possessions) the offense adds against average opposition.

entries.label: Defense
entries.desc: Points allowed against average opposition; lower is better.

entries.label: Uncertainty (±)
entries.desc: Standard error of the rating: how far it could be off with the games played so far.

entries.label: Strength of schedule
entries.desc: Mean rating of the opponents a team has played and still has to play.

entries.label: EPA
entries.desc: Expected points added: the change in expected points a play produces, from field position, down and distance.

entries.label: Success rate
entries.desc: Share of plays that gain at least half the yards needed on first down, 70% on second, all on third or fourth.

entries.label: Win probability
entries.desc: The model's pregame chance the home side wins, from the two ratings, home field and rest.

entries.label: Model margin
entries.desc: The points margin the model expects, written the way a points spread is (the favourite negative).

entries.label: Market
entries.desc: A reference beside our forecast: a prediction market's probability with its margin removed (Kalshi, Polymarket), or the closing line ESPN shows.

entries.label: Model v market
entries.desc: Our probability minus the market's, in percentage points: where the model and the market disagree, shown for reference.

entries.label: Against the spread
entries.desc: Whether a team beat the closing line; the model's side 'covers' when its pick beats the spread.

entries.label: Win probability chart
entries.desc: The chance of winning after each play; the steepest swings are the game's highest-leverage moments.

entries.label: Season simulation
entries.desc: Every remaining game played thousands of times from the ratings, with uncertainty in the ratings themselves.

entries.label: Playoff chance
entries.desc: Share of simulated seasons a team makes the 12-team College Football Playoff.

entries.label: Committee proxy
entries.desc: A model of the CFP selection committee's ranking fitted on its past rankings; an estimate of how the committee may see a team, not a prediction of its decision.

entries.label: Bracketology
entries.desc: The projected NCAA tournament field and seeds from simulated seasons and a selection model fitted on past fields.

entries.label: Reach round
entries.desc: Share of simulated tournaments in which a team reaches the round.

entries.label: Upset chance
entries.desc: The chance the lower seed wins a game.

entries.label: Value
entries.desc: Football: EPA above replacement. Basketball: box-score value above replacement, scaled so a team's players add up to its margin.

entries.label: Percentile
entries.desc: Where a player or team ranks among qualified peers, 0 (lowest) to 100 (highest).

entries.label: Inferred transfer
entries.desc: The same ESPN athlete id on a different team from one season to the next. Inferred from box scores and rosters; not the official transfer portal.

entries.label: Fantasy projection
entries.desc: Expected fantasy points for the coming period from usage, efficiency and the opponent; formats PPR, half-PPR and standard (football) and points leagues (basketball).

entries.label: Adj pass EPA (CFB)
entries.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per dropback on offense (non-garbage)

entries.label: Adj rush EPA (CFB)
entries.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per rush on offense (non-garbage)

entries.label: Block rate (MBB)
entries.desc: Blocks per opponent two-point attempt (box scores)

entries.label: Block rate (WBB)
entries.desc: Blocks per opponent two-point attempt (box scores)

entries.label: Defense (CFB)
entries.desc: Points per game prevented on defense v average

entries.label: Dropback success (CFB)
entries.desc: Share of dropbacks that gain expected points

entries.label: Dropbacks (CFB)
entries.desc: Dropbacks credited from the play-by-play (garbage time excluded)

entries.label: EPA/dropback (CFB)
entries.desc: Expected points added per dropback, sacks and interceptions included

entries.label: EPA/play (CFB)
entries.desc: EPA per credited play at the player's position

entries.label: Explosive rate (CFB)
entries.desc: Rushes of 15+ and passes of 20+ yards per play

entries.label: FGA/game (CFB)
entries.desc: Field-goal attempts per game (how much the coach uses the kicker)

entries.label: Havoc/game (CFB)
entries.desc: Tackles for loss, passes defended, interceptions and hurries per game

entries.label: Inside 20 (CFB)
entries.desc: Share of punts downed inside the 20

entries.label: Long FG (CFB)
entries.desc: Longest made field goal of the season

entries.label: Luck (MBB)
entries.desc: Wins above expectation per game (actual - model)

entries.label: Luck (WBB)
entries.desc: Wins above expectation per game (actual - model)

entries.label: Offense (CFB)
entries.desc: Points per game added on offense v average

entries.label: Opp FT rate (MBB)
entries.desc: Opponents' free-throw attempts per field-goal attempt

entries.label: Opp FT rate (WBB)
entries.desc: Opponents' free-throw attempts per field-goal attempt

entries.label: QB rush EPA (CFB)
entries.desc: Expected points added per quarterback run (designed runs and scrambles)

entries.label: Rating (CFB)
entries.desc: Expected margin v an average FBS team, neutral field

entries.label: Rating (MBB)
entries.desc: Adjusted efficiency margin per 100 possessions v an average D-I team

entries.label: Rating (WBB)
entries.desc: Adjusted efficiency margin per 100 possessions v an average D-I team

entries.label: Runs/game (CFB)
entries.desc: Designed runs and scrambles per game (style)

entries.label: Rush share (CFB)
entries.desc: Share of the team's carries in the player's games

entries.label: Rush success (CFB)
entries.desc: Share of carries that gain expected points

entries.label: Sack rate (CFB)
entries.desc: Sacks per dropback: the most quarterback-driven part of protection

entries.label: Stuff rate (CFB)
entries.desc: Share of carries stopped for no gain or a loss

entries.label: Target share (CFB)
entries.desc: Share of the team's targets thrown to the player in the player's games

entries.label: Target success (CFB)
entries.desc: Share of targets that gain expected points

entries.label: Targets (CFB)
entries.desc: Targets parsed from the play text

entries.label: Value (CFB)
entries.desc: Points above a replacement-level player (EPA for skill positions, box points for defence and specialists)

entries.label: Yds/dropback (CFB)
entries.desc: Yards per dropback after sack losses

entries.label: Yds/team att (CFB)
entries.desc: Receiving yards per team pass attempt in the player's games
